design_description: A purple netball family and supporter jersey with a clean, energetic look. The design uses a solid purple base with flowing white and lighter-purple curved bands wrapping around the lower torso, inspired by the movement of a netball. The curves sweep around the body rather than cutting across it, so the graphic reads as continuous motion while the upper chest stays open and uncluttered. The front features the Team Star identity with large GD lettering sitting prominently on the chest, framed by the clean purple field above the curved banding. The back personalizes the supporter jersey with the family name set above the oversized GD, keeping both elements large and legible from the sideline. White sleeve graphics complete the coordinated team look, tying the sleeves back to the white curves on the body. Overall it is a simple two-tone purple concept lifted by white detailing: bright and approachable enough for family and supporter wear, while still matching the on-court team identity.
